title: Bubble Sort
definition: Bubble Sort repeatedly compares adjacent values and swaps them until the array is ordered.
realLifeExample: It is like repeatedly comparing neighboring cards and moving the larger one toward the front in descending order.

algorithm.Iterative:
(Bubble Sort) BUBBLE(DATA, N)

1. Repeat Steps 2 and 3 for K = 1 to N - 1.
2. Set PTR := 1.
3. Repeat while PTR <= N - K.
   (a) If DATA[PTR] < DATA[PTR + 1], then interchange them.
   (b) Set PTR := PTR + 1.
4. Exit.
algorithm.Functions:
FUNCTION BUBBLE(DATA, N)

1. Repeat Steps 2 and 3 for K = 1 to N - 1.
2. Set PTR := 1.
3. Repeat while PTR <= N - K.
   (a) If DATA[PTR] < DATA[PTR + 1], then interchange them.
   (b) Set PTR := PTR + 1.
4. Return DATA.

MAIN:
1. Read N and DATA.
2. Call BUBBLE(DATA, N).
3. Print DATA.
algorithm.Recursion:
FUNCTION BUBBLE(DATA, N)

1. If N = 1, then return.
2. Set PTR := 1.
3. Repeat while PTR <= N - 1.
   (a) If DATA[PTR] < DATA[PTR + 1], then interchange them.
   (b) Set PTR := PTR + 1.
4. Call BUBBLE(DATA, N - 1).
